content.short: Daedalus Wallet is an open-source full-node wallet for ADA with local validation and strong custody.
content.description: Daedalus Wallet is an open-source full-node wallet for ADA built by Input Output Global for the Cardano ecosystem. Unlike a light wallet, Daedalus downloads and validates the Cardano blockchain locally, giving users a more trustless way to manage funds without relying on a centrally hosted server. It supports multiple wallets, hierarchical deterministic wallet structure, staking, and detailed control over ADA storage. Daedalus is designed for users who value security, decentralization, and full-node validation.
